disposition: The charter's leaderless decision (PD-2026-08-28-07) removes elections by design: coordinator failure is recovered by idempotent retry through another Member and membership changes go through overlapping-quorum epochs, both focused-tested, and the old single-leader plane's fencing tests still pass. Gap: no vote/term/candidate election semantics exist and no per-row accepted-difference record names the V1 election-model delta.
